title: E-QTM-0076: Jackiw-Rebbi bound state from the coined Dirac walk model: a mass wall that changes SIGN binds a state...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0076 in the quantum arena: Jackiw-Rebbi bound state from the coined Dirac walk model: a mass wall that changes SIGN binds a state at the wall (retained weight above 0.9 and constant in time), while a same-sign wall with the identical gradient binds nothing (below 0.1) and a uniform mass disperses, so the binding is the topological sign change.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
